title: Decision: Silent exit when mpsc receiver is dropped avoids false error logs on normal shutdown
description: Lines 204-206: when tx.send() returns Err (receiver dropped), the SSE task returns Ok(()) silently. The tokio::spawn wrapper (lines 171-175) then logs only if run_sse returns Err. This means normal shutdown (when the UI closes the receiver channel) produces no error log. Only actual network errors are logged. This is correct: a dropped receiver is not an error condition, it's intentional shutdown.
